description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy on Yogurt, Red Onions, Garlic and others, with effect from 18.05.2021 (Reserved)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition and specification of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains detailed regulatory information about tax rates for various commodities, which falls under the category of legal/regulatory matters. Although it is signed by the Minister of Finance, the core content is about establishing a regulatory framework and compliance requirements rather than being primarily about government personnel or structure.
